text:
deploybot: starting staged rollout v2026-03-01-rc3 -> 10% traffic eu-west at 17:02 UTC. monitor: latency, 5xxs, embed-errors. status: IN_PROGRESS
alex: saw 95p tail jump ~120ms at minute 2, small but notable. digging.
sara: my dashboard shows p95 from 210 -> 335ms for infer-service in eu-west, correlated with a brief CPU reclaim on one pool.
jamal: can you paste the query? which model variant?
alex: model: openlm-l7-quant, route: text-gen-v2. metrics query: `sum(rate(latency_bucket{le=\"0.95\"}[1m]))` (quick paste)
megan: @ryan_oncall can we hold at 10% while infra checks the node? prefer not to push to 25 until we understand tail.
ryan_oncall: acknowledging. I'll check host metrics + kvcache churn. Give me 90s.
deploybot: current rollout: 10% -> 10% (no change). recent health: 0.4% 5xx (baseline 0.2%), p95 latency increased 58%.
jamal: that 0.4% 5xx seems to be spiking from a single backend shard (eu-west-3). logs show transient OOM and `kvcache miss` thrash.
alex: agree. I can reproduce locally with a short run and see kv eviction thrash when seq len > 1k on this quant path.
sara: given the OOM hint, I'd vote pause and pin traffic back to previous model for eu-west. We should avoid spillover to other regions. :thumbsdown: on continuation.
megan: +1 pause. also requested rollback playbook in case pause doesn't stop smoothing.
ryan_oncall: quickvote - pause? react :+1: for pause, :-1: for continue.
jamal: +1 pause
alex: +1 pause
sara: +1 pause
megan: +1 pause
deploybot: received consensus: 5 votes pause, 0 continue. executing staged rollout pause...
deploybot: pause complete. pinning eu-west traffic to v2026-02-28-stable. verifying routing config...
deploybot: routing change applied. 10% remained on stable, canary drained to 0%. health: 5xx -> 0.18%, p95 back toward baseline.
ryan_oncall: infra: found one host with nvml OOM trace, restarted the GPU worker, and bumped KV cache size for that pool. also applied a temporary evict-threshold increase.
jamal: good. I'm going to run a targeted load test against the quant path to confirm stabilization.
alex: I'll prepare a narrow eval set (long sequences) and run 10k requests at low qps to observe tail.
sara: ops: please open a follow-up ticket to investigate quant memory regression in v2026-03-01-rc3 — include reproducer, heap traces, and kernel logs. tag: release/rc3-memory.
megan: can we also add a note to release notes draft: "paused canary for rc3 due to kv-cache memory pressure in eu-west; rolling back canary; investigating". keep it short and factual.
deploybot: created ticket REL-1289 and updated rollout audit. assign: jamal, priority: P1->P2 once repro validated.
ryan_oncall: timeline: pause at +55s, infra restart +4m, kv tweak +6m, canary drained +7m. recommend holding until load test results in 30m.
jamal: agreed. I'll post results in this thread when done.
alex: will also add perf graphs and a short snippet of the failing stack trace when available.
sara: thanks all. good quickcall. if load test looks good, we can reconvene for a slow bump to 15% with tighter sentinel thresholds. :thumbsup:
megan: noted — prepping an amended rollout plan with rollback gates and a quiet window.
ryan_oncall: marking incident as mitigated for now. keep this thread open for postmortem notes.
jamal: load test starting now (target 10k requests over 20m). will report at +20m.
alex: ping me if you want me to join live to correlate traces.
megan: thanks everyone.
(automated) deploybot: thread audit: action=paused; rollout=v2026-03-01-rc3; region=eu-west; reason=\"kv-cache memory pressure leading to tail latency & transient OOM\"; ticket=REL-1289
